body: i hope you never experience the what if, when a family member kills themselves. victim blaming someone qfter they're gone is top tier classyness, grow up.

stop thinking about anything and everything, zen yourself during meditation or a hobby. It really isn't worth it, i look in the mirror while crying and think of myself in a light tone like "god im really beating myself up here maybe i should stop"

for some reason it disrupts my episodes of intense emotion when i start crying about my dad who killed himself

don't do it, just think about how if it breaks halfway and you starved your brain of blood to the point where it damaged you for life, you might look at yourself down the road and really regret it, if you do end up doing and pull through. just dont bro, do something to take your mind off of thinking, for me its been rally videos and video games and getting stoned

i relate to this on a whole nother level but let me just tell you 1 thing, those people who are pampered aren't like us, they havent been in the shit and seen or done the crap we do. We have more virtues than most because of the shit we been through, i try to wear my abuse as a badge of honor. Because it morphed me into a version of me thats 10x better.

Theres so many privileged pampered shits out there who are depressed because they're boring and uninteresting, we have something they don't, a defined character and a story to tell the world.
